name: oracle_record
title: Forward validation oracle — one TV capture per (capture_ts, sec_id)
description: Daily after-close capture of TradingView's live values + screen decisions, used to monitor the engine<->TV delta over time. NOT a source of backtest history. See ../CONFORMANCE.md.

fields.name: capture_ts
fields.description: When the capture ran (UTC). Distinguishes as-captured from later TV revisions.

fields.name: as_of_date
fields.description: The trading date the captured values represent.

fields.name: sec_id
fields.description: Resolved from ticker via reference/ticker_map as-of as_of_date. The join key.

fields.name: w1_pass
fields.description: TV-evaluated TASI-W1 decision (null if not evaluable).

fields.name: engine_spec_version
fields.description: Spec version the engine used when this row was reconciled (provenance).

x-invariants: append-only; never mutate a captured row (a TV revision is a NEW row with a later capture_ts)
rule decisions (w*_pass) are compared to the engine's evaluation of ../spec/rules.yaml under CONFORMANCE.md borderline handling
